sloka: रामा रम्ये वनोद् देशे मया विरहिता त्वया ।क्रुद्धो अब्रवीत् गिरिम् तत्र सिंहः क्षुद्र मृगम् यथा ॥३-६४-३०॥
transliteration: rāmā ramye vanod deśe mayā virahitā tvayā ।kruddho abravīt girim tatra siṁhaḥ kṣudra mṛgam yathā ॥3-64-30॥

translations.english: Like a lion aiming at a petty animal, angry Rama said, O Mountain before I destroy all your slopes show me that goldenhued Sita with lustre like gold.
